main.description: An athlete starred a segment, to keep it in their list of starred segments. Lives only in the athlete's self space (app.activitytracker.space.athlete, key self), never in the public repo, and only the athlete reads it: the AppView, which syncs self, never stores or serves it. Its rkey is the first 20 bytes of SHA-256 over the segment's AT-URI, lowercase base32 without padding, so an athlete has at most one star per segment. Deleting it unstars the segment.
